Aurora Kettle Support Handbook

Warranty
The warranty covers manufacturing defects in the heating element, the base, and the lid hinge. To claim, you must provide your receipt and the serial number located under the base of the kettle. Damage caused by dropping the kettle or descaling with unapproved chemicals is not covered.

Descaling
Use only the approved Aurora citric descaler, one sachet per fill. Fill the kettle to the MAX line, boil once, and let it stand for twenty minutes. Rinse with fresh water three times afterwards. Never use vinegar, because it damages the silicone seal of the lid hinge.

Specifications
The 2025 model holds 1.6 L, up from 1.2 L in the 2023 model. It boils a full kettle in about three minutes using a 2200 W heating element. The body is brushed stainless steel and the cord is 0.75 m long.

Customer support
Customer support replies to every email within two business days. Urgent safety issues are escalated the same day. Support is available Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00 Central European Time.

The mascot
Pip is a small blue penguin. Pip was designed in 2021 by the in-house art team. Pip appears on the packaging, on the lid of the limited edition kettles, and in the mobile app.
